description: Official `ragas` evaluation of the agentic-RAG tool, run from the isolated .venv-ragas (ragas is incompatible with the project's pinned langchain 1.x stack, so it lives in its own venv). Judge LLM: Google Gemini; embeddings: local Sentence-Transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2.

verified_partial_run.note: Real ragas output observed on a 2-item run. answer_relevancy was not captured in this run because the Gemini embedding model 404'd; the runner was subsequently switched to local Sentence-Transformers embeddings, so a full re-run captures all four metrics.

full_run_blocker.reason: Google Gemini free-tier quota is 20 generate-requests/day PER MODEL (GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier). A full 5-item x 4-metric ragas run needs dozens of judge calls; the day's quota across gemini-3.5/3.6/3.8-flash was exhausted during app runs, evidence capture and eval attempts.
remedies: Re-run after the daily quota resets (00:00 Pacific): .venv-ragas/Scripts/python.exe scripts/run_official_ragas.py
Use a paid/higher-quota Gemini key or project.
The self-contained RAGAS-style evaluator (evidence/ragas_report.json) gives full, reproducible metrics with no LLM quota dependency.
